note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration dictionary with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It defines model architecture settings for GA-RetinaNet (Guided Anchoring RetinaNet) using a ResNet-50 Caffe backbone with FPN on COCO. It inherits from retinanet_r50-caffe_fpn_1x_coco.py and overrides bbox_head to GARetinaHead with guided anchoring training settings.
summarize_config: summarize the GA-RetinaNet configuration for guided anchoring with ResNet-50 Caffe FPN on COCO
review_bbox_head: review the GARetinaHead bbox_head config including anchor generators and loss functions
review_train_cfg: review the training config with ApproxMaxIoUAssigner and RandomSampler settings
review_loss_functions: review the loss functions including FocalLoss, BoundedIoULoss, and SmoothL1Loss
review_optim_wrapper: review the gradient clipping optimization wrapper with max_norm 35
